findings.text: During a 12-second window with no user interaction, the page made 44 requests to 15 third-party domains (median of 3 passes).

5 third-party services classified as advertising, analytics, social or audience measurement were contacted before any interaction: ads-twitter.com (X, advertising), amazon-adsystem.com (Amazon, advertising), analytics.google.com (Google, analytics), doubleclick.net (Google, advertising), parsely.com (Parse.ly, analytics).
7 cookies were set by third-party domains (17 cookies in total).
